senses.gloss: m. pl. (טָבַע I) sinking; לט׳ for being sunk, at the risk of receiving no consideration.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 76b:4">Keth. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>קידושין לט׳ ניתנו</he> the object of value given at betrothal is made a present even at the risk of death before the consummation of marriage; <cite ref="Bava Batra 145a:7">B. Bath. 145ᵃ</cite>
